description: Submit one de-identified firsthand observation under your own operating authority and platform rules. Public reports enter private review and are not site-status claims. Never include names, account details, URLs, cookies, tokens, or conversation text. Add cause with cause_basis only when you established the cause from one of the four listed bases, never as a guess; otherwise leave both out.

CauseBasis.description: D109: what the reporting agent established the cause from.
CauseBasis.title: CauseBasis

ObservationCause.description:
D109: the cause the reporting agent says it established, by the layer it points at. There is no "unknown" value: a
report that did not establish a cause leaves the field out.
ObservationCause.title: ObservationCause

agent_family.description: Which agent family you are: dots, muse, or other (the default; use it if neither fits).

attempt_actor.description: Who made the attempt: agent (you, the default) or human (the person did it themselves).

attempt_env.description: Where the attempt ran: agent_cloud_browser (a browser run by an agent in the cloud; needs attempt_actor agent), human_in_agent_browser or human_own_browser (a person at a browser; needs attempt_actor human), or unknown (the default).

cause.description: Optional, with cause_basis, for outcome blocked or error: the cause you established. Leave out if not established.

cause_basis.description: Required with cause: what you established it from.

challenge_kind.description: What the challenge looked like: interactive_check (a box or puzzle to complete), loop (the check kept repeating), block_page (a page that only says access is denied), unknown, or none (the default; no challenge).

challenge_vendor.description: Which bot-check provider showed a challenge: cloudflare, recaptcha, hcaptcha, unknown (a challenge from another or unclear provider), or none (the default; no challenge).

consent_confirmed.description: Legacy field kept for older clients. It is not used to decide anything; leave it out.
consent_confirmed.title: Consent Confirmed

error_class.description: What kind of stop it was: site_access (page or API refused or unreachable), login_auth (sign-in failed or an extra verification step appeared), human_verification (a CAPTCHA or a verify-you-are-human check), or service_error (the site returned an error or timed out).

idempotency_key.description: A UUID that makes a resend safe: sending the same key with the same body again does not create a second record. Leave it out to get a new one.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

observed_at.description: When the attempt happened, as an ISO 8601 time with a timezone offset, for example 2026-11-01T07:10:00Z. Leave it out for an attempt that just happened. Must be within the last 7 days and not in the future.
observed_at.title: Observed At

outcome.description: How the attempt ended: passed (it worked), blocked (the site or a check stopped it), error (it failed with an error), or abandoned (you or the person stopped before the end).

schema_version.description: Report format version. Always 1; leave it out.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

site_host.description: The public hostname the attempt was about, for example example.com. Only the host: no scheme, path, query, port or credentials.
site_host.title: Site Host

synthetic.description: true only for a made-up test report. Leave it out (false) for a real attempt.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

task_step.description: What you were trying to do, as a short lowercase code of letters, digits and underscores that starts with a letter, for example login, checkout or status_check. Default other.
task_step.title: Task Step

observation.description: The observation to submit: site_host, error_class and outcome are required; the other fields are optional and described one by one. Only coded values and the public hostname; no names, account details, URLs, cookies, tokens or conversation text.

name: report_observation
